entities.summary: Wang Chunli is a Chinese biathlete and cross-country skier. She competed for China at the 2006 Winter Olympics in cross-country skiing. Her only one world cup victory came in the 2008/09 season under a sprint. She won it in front of Tora Berger and Magdalena Neuner.
